metadata.title: New Wave Autumnal Group Portrait
useCases: Editorial fashion spreads with a collegiate theme

retrievalProfile.description: A high-angle group portrait featuring subjects in white knitwear lying on a bed of dry leaves, framed by bold diagonal and vertical yellow banners with heavy sans-serif type.
triggerTerms: overhead group shot in autumn leaves
excludeWhen: a minimalist modern aesthetic is required
dark or moody lighting is requested
the subject is a single person

recipe.visualDefinition: A bird's-eye view of six young men lying in various orientations on a dense carpet of brown autumn leaves. They wear white cable-knit sweaters and collared shirts. The composition is framed by graphic yellow bars: a horizontal one at the top, a vertical one on the right, and a diagonal corner banner at the bottom left, all containing bold, spaced-out black text.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast white knitwear against earthy brown leaf textures
Geometric yellow graphic overlays framing an organic, chaotic background
Multiple eye-lines creating a non-linear, candid group dynamic
Repetitive texture of cable-knit patterns echoing the jagged edges of dry leaves
coreInvariants: Dominant use of white, yellow, and brown
Heavy, wide-set sans-serif typography on solid color blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six subjects fill the central frame, scaled to appear life-sized within the square format, arranged in a circular cluster.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow graphic banners act as the structural anchor, containing the organic subjects within a rigid frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye enters at the top-left banner, follows the subjects' faces in a clockwise spiral, and exits via the bottom-left diagonal banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with leaves and figures, with the yellow bars serving as the only 'breathing' room.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value whites and high-saturation yellows pop against a low-saturation, mid-value brown background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon colors except for the specific primary yellow
Stick to natural skin tones and organic leaf shades

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in varying orientations and sizes for consistency.
graphicDevices: Parallel black lines/hatching on yellow background

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s/80s pop aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and circular counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A square photograph from a top-down perspective showing six young men with 80s hairstyles lying on a thick bed of dry, brown autumn leaves. They are wearing white cable-knit sweaters and white shirts. The lighting is bright and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid yellow bar across the top and down the right side. Add a diagonal yellow triangle in the bottom-left corner. Place bold, black, wide-spaced lowercase sans-serif text inside these yellow areas.

verificationChecks: Are the yellow banners solid and opaque?
Is the text lowercase with extreme letter spacing?
Is the clothing predominantly white cable-knit?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Specific shade of yellow for banners
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific band name or album title
Ensure the faces are unique and not copies of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the knitwear and leaves
Clean, sharp graphic edges on the yellow banners
Balanced distribution of figures across the frame

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible against the yellow background
Ensure the diagonal banner doesn't obscure too much of the subjects
Verify the 80s collegiate fashion aesthetic is maintained
Confirm the overhead angle is consistent across all subjects
recipe.reuseFormula: Group portrait + overhead angle + autumn leaves + white knitwear + yellow geometric banners + wide-tracked sans-serif type.
